info.name: EARLY (Timeular) Public Activities Tags & Mentions API

description.content:
Public REST API for EARLY (formerly Timeular) time tracking. Manage activities, time entries, live tracking, tags & mentions, folders, users, leaves, and webhook subscriptions. Authentication is via API Key + API Secret exchanged for a Bearer Access Token. Derived by API Evangelist from the provider-published public Postman collection.
